facts.fact: GIZ's factsheet on its support to the Cameroonian police, status June 2020, states that a digitised system for processing and transmitting information on investigations, criminal proceedings, arrest warrants, fines and current sanctions is barely used, which it puts down to weak institutional and management capacity; it gives no count of the units using it and does not say where entries are made.
facts.system: système numérisé de traitement et de transmission d'informations sur les enquêtes, les procédures pénales, les mandats d'arrêt, les amendes et les sanctions

facts.fact: GIZ's factsheet, status June 2020, presents the barely used digitised investigations and proceedings system as the Délégation générale à la sûreté nationale's own, saying the DGSN must besides overcome unreliable internet connection, electricity and computer equipment; it names no other operator, plan or budget line for the system.
facts.system: système numérisé de traitement et de transmission d'informations sur les enquêtes, les procédures pénales, les mandats d'arrêt, les amendes et les sanctions

systems.owner: Délégation générale à la sûreté nationale (DGSN), as the document implies
systems.tiers: not stated; barely used as of June 2020

systems.owner: police judiciaire (DGSN), supported by the GIZ programme

note: The record system is classed on the document's description alone (information on investigations and criminal proceedings, processed and transmitted digitally); the document does not say that stations enter cases in it, nor how the record is made. The GIZ project (July 2019 to December 2022, about EUR 2.77 million, German Federal Foreign Office) is not stated to finance that system.
